Our Love Story

It started with a simple hello…

From classmates to friends, from besties to something more — every chapter brought us closer to the forever we always dreamed of.

Chapter 01

Chapter 1 – Just Classmates

We were just classmates at first — simple smiles, small conversations and familiar faces.

Tab hume nahi pata tha ki yahi se hamari beautiful story shuru hone wali hai.

Among college corridors, lectures and everyday moments, two classmates crossed paths. Innocent smiles and quiet glances slowly became a memory neither of them knew would mean so much.

Just a beginning…
Chapter 02

Chapter 2 – Just Friends

From sharing notes to sharing laughs, we slowly became good friends.

Har din baat karna aur ek dusre ki help karna normal sa ho gaya.

Notes, exams, conversations and little moments of help turned strangers into friends. The bond grew naturally — warm, genuine and beautifully effortless.

And friendship found its way…
Chapter 03

Chapter 3 – Besties

Endless conversations, silly jokes and memories we never wanted to end.

Dheere dheere tu sirf friend nahi raha… tu mera best friend ban gaya.

Endless conversations, uncontrollable laughter and sharing every little detail of life. Somewhere along the way, they became each other's favourite person.

Best friends, best memories.
Chapter 04

Chapter 4 – Something More

Then something changed. The friendship started feeling a little more special.

Shayad dil ko pehle hi pata tha… ye friendship kuch aur banne wali hai.

Then came the meaningful eye contact, the shy smiles and the feeling that this friendship was becoming something deeper. Under a beautiful sunset, they slowly realised they were meant for each other.

Maybe this was love all along…
Chapter 05

Chapter 5 – Forever Begins

From classmates to friends, friends to besties, and besties to forever.

Finally, our forever begins. ❤️

And now, surrounded by love, blessings and beautiful dreams, the journey takes its most precious turn — not an ending, but the beginning of a lifetime together.

Our forever starts here.
The moment everything changed
“And then… friendship became love.”
“A new chapter begins…”
💍

Two hearts. One forever.
